summary: Classifies a float argument into a small integer status code by threshold: returns 2 when a1 is below 0.61650002, 3 when below 0.69999999, 5 when at or above 0.88, and 4 otherwise. Consumers sub_4FF130 and AudioFilterParameterCalculation convert computed floats into these discrete codes.

operations.description: Return the default status code 4 when a1 is within [0.69999999, 0.88).

unresolved: Globals flt_59E6E8 (0x0059E6E8), flt_5A0038 (0x005A0038) and flt_5AD334 (0x005AD334) are listed as read by this function but never appear in the raw source; they likely back the threshold literals 0.61650002 / 0.69999999 / 0.88 but the mapping is not established.
The meaning of the status codes 2-5 is not named in the packet; consumers sub_4FF130 (0x004FF130) and AudioFilterParameterCalculation (0x004FF1D0) interpret them.
The legacy ABI label Threshold_Based_Return (abi:lead) is not adopted as an independent owner claim.
